scope: Receive-only text inbox for managed YCloud/Kapso accounts; existing shadow intake and legacy paths preserved

implementation.rollout: Both CHANNEL_ACCOUNT_INGRESS_CONNECTIONS and CHANNEL_ACCOUNT_INBOX_CONNECTIONS require explicit connection UUIDs. Empty is off; no wildcard, no workspace or AI/outbound flag inheritance
implementation.atomicity: Service-only INVOKER RPC with empty search_path captures normalized event, verifies source revision under existing source locks, resolves contact/account identity/thread, inserts text and updates unread/window in one transaction. Late failures roll back every artifact
implementation.isolation: Existing verified account identity owns its contact even after contact.phone edits. New identities may share a contact by exact verified E164; identities, conversations and messages remain connection scoped. No adoption of legacy NULL-routed history
implementation.dedup: Same-account retries return existing IDs and do not inflate unread or mutate operator state. Same message ID on different accounts produces distinct messages/threads. Changed envelope/body is rejected
implementation.policy: New contacts opt_in=false; existing consent/profile/suppression untouched. New threads human_active, ai_enabled=false. Existing active-AI threads reject new intake; duplicate existing messages preserve state. Windows derive from occurredAt, not retries or receipts
implementation.limits: Text/rawType=text only. Media remains shadow-captured with stable IDs, no download/transcription/model. Receipts retain separate ledger and exact account reconciliation, no inbox/unread mutation
implementation.ack: Shadow ACK unchanged when inbox flag off or receipt/media; text materialization ACK received:true,shadowOnly:false,recorded:true,inboxOnly:true,materialized:true. No private IDs or credentials
implementation.historical: Historical shadow events cannot become live identity evidence. Source rotation/expiry/revocation invalidates in-flight/replayed materialization

tests.cloudSql: Same PostgreSQL17 atomic inbox/replay/three-account isolation/Kapso/edited-phone/rotation/ACL probe passes locally and Cloud under service_role; all SQL probe writes rolled back
tests.httpFlow: Local Next3100 -> PostgREST -> Cloud SQL: two YCloud and one Kapso signed synthetic sources, same actor/message ID, exact account binding, replay/collision/wrong destination/future/signature/receipt/media/revoke. Real QA login/RLS reads and production readInboxPage/readComposerAvailability verify per-account filters and blocked composer
tests.safetyLimit: All payloads, numbers, keys and provider proof were synthetic. No provider/model network requests. Auth/DB requests are real. These tests do not prove provider delivery or new-account onboarding in production
tests.browser: No browser actions or workaround; prior URL policy denial remains. No new UI changes. Interactive/responsive review of account forms30/32 still pending; no new Realtime browser test
tests.build: No repeated production build; full suites/typecheck/lint/actual HTTP+DB verification

cloud.advisorChange: No new findings; grouped count/findings summed
cloud.cleanup: Guarded cleanup checks exact fixture ID/slug/name/account allowlist, synthetic inbound bodies and no consent/jobs/outbox/integrations. Removes workspace00000000-0000-4000-9000-000000003301, four events, three messages/threads/identities, one contact, credentials/receipt/accounts/membership and workspace events.
